impact: Adds export-control and political pressure on NVDA a week before its Nov 17 earnings; tighter chip curbs would weigh on the AI chip complex including MU and DRAM.
source: Reuters via US News / Unusual Whales
summary: Reuters reported that Northwestern Polytechnical University, on the US Entity List since 2001, paid about $123,000 for two Nvidia H200 chips in October through a domestic supplier. A Reuters review of 26 records found other Chinese universities buying restricted Nvidia chips or renting Nvidia-powered compute. Three Republican committee chairs have requested a Nov 18 briefing with Nvidia's CEO over separate spy allegations.
title: PLA-linked Chinese university bought Nvidia H200s despite US blacklist
